$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.check.haxe.expressions. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-PSE-USING-INSERT-SILENT
arms.note: the merged `using` insert answers `true` whether or not it was appended, so `prefer-static-extension` keeps rewrites whose declaration never landed

arms.name: M-FACTS-FIXED-CAPTURE
arms.note: no constructor capture counts as fixed, so a capture typed closed stays report-only

arms.name: M-FACTS-FIXED-LOOP
arms.note: no loop binder counts as fixed, so a binder over a call with a closed result stays report-only

arms.name: M-FACTS-FIXED-ANY-BINDER
arms.find: if (decl == null || !FactsBindings.fixedAt(oracle, file, root, decl, s.shape)) return Verdict.UnresolvedReceiver;
arms.note: every inferred binding is asked of the facts, so a receiver a later call typed is rewritten and no longer compiles

arms.name: M-PSE-FACTS-INFERRED
arms.note: an unannotated local, whose type the rewritten call itself may have bound, is typed by the facts

arms.name: M-PSE-FACTS-OFF
arms.note: a receiver only the compiler's facts type stays report-only

arms.name: M-PSE-FACTS-SHADOW
arms.find: for (id in chain) if (facts.type(id)?.fields.exists(f -> f.name == method) == true) return Shadowed;
arms.note: a same-name member of a supertype or an interface no longer drops the site

arms.name: M-PSE-FACTS-HOSTS
arms.note: a forwarding abstract counts as a member host whose own fields are its members

arms.name: M-PSE-FACTS-USING
arms.note: a receiver type's own @:using, which wins over the file's, is ignored

arms.name: M-PSE-FACTS-PARAM
arms.note: an abstract first parameter, reached through @:from, is taken as accepting the receiver

arms.name: M-PSE-FACTS-OVERLOAD
arms.note: an overloaded static is judged by its first signature, the only one the facts field records

arms.name: M-PSE-FACTS-DYNAMIC
arms.note: a Dynamic receiver is reported instead of dropped

arms.name: M-PSE-FACTS-NULL
arms.note: a nullable receiver is read as the Null abstract, which hosts no member

arms.name: M-PSE-FACTS-TEXT
arms.note: facts of the text the compile read answer for a file edited since

arms.name: M-PSE-FIRST-PARAM
arms.note: the last parameter of a facts signature is read as its first

arms.name: M-PSE-CHANNEL-ALIAS
arms.note: a module name an import alias rebinds to another type keeps the site as a candidate

arms.name: M-PSE-CHANNEL-REGION-USING
arms.replace: for (child in node.children) if (child.kind != 'Conditional') collectUsings(child, out);
arms.note: a using inside a conditional region is invisible to the conflict gate

arms.name: M-PSE-CLOSURE-USING
arms.note: the structural path ignores @:using on the receiver's type closure

arms.name: M-PSE-FACTS-USING-MODULE-WIDE
arms.note: the facts weigh only the type a using names, not the rest of its module

arms.name: M-PSE-FACTS-USING-SELF-MODULE
arms.note: the facts do not weigh the other types of the configured module

arms.name: M-SUBSTR-ANY-START
arms.note: every substr start is flagged, not only a subtraction

arms.name: M-RCMP-ANY-OPERAND-TYPE
arms.note: every operand type is accepted, so a Float chain, which answers 0 for a NaN where Reflect.compare answers a sign, is rewritten

arms.name: M-RCMP-IMPURE-OPERAND
arms.note: an operand that runs code is accepted, so a call the chain evaluates twice is evaluated once by the rewrite

arms.name: M-RCMP-ANY-TERMINAL
arms.note: any closing value is accepted, so a chain that answers something other than 0 for equal operands is rewritten

arms.name: M-RCMP-ANY-CALL
arms.note: every two-parameter function literal passed to any call is read as a comparator, whose exact -1 / 1 a caller outside a sort may read

arms.name: M-RCMP-ANY-NONNULL
arms.note: every chain is rewritten, so one that answers 0 for a null operand is rewritten into a call that answers -1

arms.name: M-RCMP-MIXED-OPERANDS
arms.note: the right operand's type is not compared, so an Int against a Float is rewritten into a call that does not compile

arms.name: M-RCMP-NONNULL-EITHER
arms.note: one proved operand is enough, so a chain whose other operand may be null is rewritten into a call that answers differently

arms.name: M-RCMP-BARE-ANY-ORDER
arms.note: any two operands count as the parameters in order, so a swapped comparison loses its lambda and the sort turns over

arms.name: M-RCMP-BARE-NOT-WHOLE
arms.note: a chain closing a longer body replaces the whole callback, so the statements before it are deleted

arms.name: M-RCMP-MOVE-IGNORED
arms.note: a Reflect.compare call in a callback is never moved to the function the project names

arms.name: M-RCMP-BARE-ANY-ELEMENT
arms.note: the element type is not read, so a bare Reflect.compare over any array moves to the Int function and does not compile

arms.name: M-RCMP-ANY-NAMED
arms.note: the chain operand type does not pick the function, so an Int chain is rewritten to the String function

arms.name: M-RCMP-MOVE-NONNULL
arms.note: a moved call is fixed without a proof of non-null, where Reflect.compare and the typed function answer differently

arms.name: M-RCMP-IMPORT-LOST
arms.find: edits.push({ span: edit.span, text: edit.text, group: group });
arms.replace: edits.push({ span: edit.span, text: '', group: group });
arms.note: the fix writes the short name of the function and no import of its type, so the file stops compiling

arms.name: M-RCMP-UNRESOLVED-SILENT
arms.find: problems.push('$key.$type: the resolution index declares no "$path"');
arms.note: a name the index cannot find is dropped in silence and the rule falls back to Reflect.compare

arms.name: M-RCMP-ANY-SIGNATURE
arms.note: any declaration of the name is accepted, so the fix writes a call that does not compile or does not compare

arms.name: M-RCMP-ERROR-NO-FILE
arms.note: the configuration error stands on no file, where the per-file gate reads a default-off rule as off and drops it from every normal run

arms.name: M-RCMP-ERROR-FIRST-FILE
arms.note: the error stays on the first file seen, which the gate drops when the rule is off there though it is on elsewhere

arms.name: M-RCMP-MOVE-ANY-POSITION
arms.note: a call read for more than its sign is rewritten, so a callback doing arithmetic on it sorts differently under a function of another magnitude
